arxiv-1908-04972.title: Complete basis for the pentaquark wave function in a group theory approach
arxiv-1908-04972.creator: K. Xu, A. Kaewsnod, X. Y. Liu, S. Srisuphaphon, A. Limphirat, Y. Yan
arxiv-1908-04972.description: Abstract Permutation groups are applied to analyze the symmetries of pentaquark states. All possible quark configurations of the color, flavor, spin and spatial degrees of freedom are worked out in the language of permutation groups, and the corresponding wave functions are constructed systematically in the form of a Yamanouchi basis.

arxiv-2201-04412.title: Quantum jump metrology in a two-cavity network
arxiv-2201-04412.creator: Kawthar Al Rasbi, 1,2 Almut Beige 1 and Lewis A. Clark 3
arxiv-2201-04412.description: Abstract Quantum metrology enhances measurement precision by utilising the properties of quantum physics. In interferometry, this is typically achieved by evolving highly-entangled quantum states before performing single-shot measurements to reveal information about an unknown parameter. While this is often the optimum approach, implementation with all but the smallest states is still extremely challenging.

arxiv-2212-08500.title: Upper bound on the Guessing probability using Machine Learning
arxiv-2212-08500.creator: Sarnava Datta, Hermann Kampermann, Dagmar Bruß
arxiv-2212-08500.description: Abstract The estimation of the guessing probability has paramount importance in quantum cryptographic processes. It can also be used as a witness for nonlocal correlations. In most of the studied scenarios, estimating the guessing probability amounts to solving a semi-definite programme, for which potent algorithms exist.

arxiv-2303-12298.title: A General Algorithm for Solving Rank-one Matrix Sensing
arxiv-2303-12298.creator: Lianke Qin, Zhao Song, Ruizhe Zhang
arxiv-2303-12298.description: A 2023 arXiv research paper by Lianke Qin, Zhao Song, Ruizhe Zhang. Matrix sensing has many real-world applications in science and engineering, such as system control, distance embedding, and computer vision. The goal of matrix sensing is to recover a matrix A ⋆ ∈ ℝ n × n A_{\star}\in\mathbb{R}^{n\times n} , based on a sequence of measurements ( u i , b i ) ∈ ℝ n × ℝ (u_{i},b_{i})\in\mathbb{R}^{n}\times\mathbb{R} such that u i ⊤ ​ A ⋆ ​ u i = b i u_{i}^{\top}A_{\star}u_{i}=b_{i} .

arxiv-2309-07225.title: Breaking Free with AI: The Deconfinement Transition
arxiv-2309-07225.creator: Christian Ermann, Stephen Baker, Mohamed M. Anber
arxiv-2309-07225.description: Abstract Employing supervised machine learning techniques, we investigate the deconfinement phase transition within 4 4 -dimensional S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) Yang-Mills (YM) theory, compactified on a small circle and endowed with center-stabilizing potential. This exploration encompasses scenarios both without and with matter in either the fundamental or adjoint representations.

arxiv-2310-17068.title: Novel moduli space in modular flavor models : a case study for modular T ′ T^{\prime} seesaw model with hidden S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) gauge symmetry Preprint: KEK-TH-2567 KYUSHU-HET-271
arxiv-2310-17068.creator: Keiya Ishiguro 1, Takaaki Nomura 2, Hiroshi Okada 3, Yuta Orikasa 4, Hajime Otsuka 3
arxiv-2310-17068.description: Abstract We study flavor phenomenologies in a basis of a double covering of modular A 4 A_{4} group with a hidden S ​ U ​ ( 2 ) SU(2) symmetry, in which we work on regions at nearby two fixed points and three special points.

arxiv-2311-05736.title: An algorithm for scaling vectors by the reciprocal of a complex number
arxiv-2311-05736.creator: Weslley da Silva Pereira
arxiv-2311-05736.description: Abstract This document describes an algorithm to scale a complex vector by the reciprocal of a complex value. The algorithm computes the reciprocal of the complex value and then scales the vector by the reciprocal. Some scaling may be necessary due to this 2-step strategy, and the proposed algorithm takes scaling into account.

arxiv-2401-07110.title: Hebbian Learning from First Principles
arxiv-2401-07110.creator: Linda Albanese, Adriano Barra, Pierluigi Bianco, Fabrizio Durante, Diego Pallara
arxiv-2401-07110.description: Abstract Recently, the original storage prescription for the Hopfield model of neural networks – as well as for its dense generalizations – has been turned into a genuine Hebbian learning rule by postulating the expression of its Hamiltonian for both the supervised and unsupervised protocols.

arxiv-2403-09868.title: The Quantum Gaussian-Schell Model: A Link Between Classical and Quantum Optics
arxiv-2403-09868.creator: Riley B. Dawkins, Mingyuan Hong, Chenglong You, Omar S. Magaña-Loaiza
arxiv-2403-09868.description: Abstract The quantum theory of the electromagnetic field uncovered that classical forms of light were indeed produced by distinct superpositions of nonclassical multiphoton wavepackets. Specifically, partially coherent light represents the most common kind of classical light. Here, for the first time, we demonstrate the extraction of the constituent multiphoton quantum systems of a partially coherent light field.

arxiv-2507-03452.title: Multiplier Between Generalized Toeplitz Kernels
arxiv-2507-03452.creator: Anjali and R. K. Srivastava
arxiv-2507-03452.description: Abstract . We develop a structural classification of multipliers between generalized Toeplitz kernels, extending the work of Fricain and Rupam. Our results establish new equivalences between multiplier space and Carleson-type embeddings, linking them to Beurling Malliavin densities, Pólya sequences, and the spectral theory of entire functions. 2020 Mathematics Subject Classification Primary 30D20; Secondary 42A50. 1.

arxiv-2508-11108.title: Short mollifiers of the Riemann zeta-function
arxiv-2508-11108.creator: J. B. Conrey, D. W. Farmer, C.-H. Kwan, Y. Lin, C. L. Turnage-Butterbaugh
arxiv-2508-11108.description: Abstract . We apply the calculus of variations to construct a new sequence of linear combinations of derivatives of the Riemann ζ \zeta -function adapted to Levinson’s method, which yield a positive proportion of zeros of the ζ \zeta -function on the critical line, regardless of how short the mollifier is. Our construction extends readily to modular L L -functions.

arxiv-2511-05345.title: The 𝒓 − 𝟑 \boldsymbol{r^{-3}} Curvature Decay and the Infrared Structure of Linearized Gravity
arxiv-2511-05345.creator: Michael Wilson
arxiv-2511-05345.description: Abstract We identify curvature decay | Riem | ∼ r − 3 |{\rm Riem}|\!\sim\!r^{-3} as a sharp spectral threshold in linearized gravity on asymptotically flat manifolds. For faster decay, the spatial Lichnerowicz operator possesses a purely continuous spectrum σ ess ​ ( L ) = [ 0 , ∞ ) \sigma_{\mathrm{ess}}(L)=[0,\infty) , corresponding to freely radiating tensor modes.

arxiv-2601-10453.title: Stable Differentiable Modal Synthesis for Learning Nonlinear Dynamics
arxiv-2601-10453.creator: Victor Zheleznov, Stefan Bilbao, Alec Wright, Simon King
arxiv-2601-10453.description: Abstract Modal methods are a long-standing approach to physical modelling synthesis. Extensions to nonlinear problems are possible, including the case of a high-amplitude vibration of a string. A modal decomposition leads to a densely coupled nonlinear system of ordinary differential equations.

pmc-11584332.title: Recent Trends in Liver Cancer: Epidemiology, Risk Factors, and Diagnostic Techniques
pmc-11584332.creator: Shivani R Kale, Geeta Karande, Anand Gudur, Aishwarya Garud, Monika S Patil, Satish Patil
pmc-11584332.description: Liver cancer, particularly hepatocellular carcinoma (HCC), poses a significant global health challenge due to its high mortality rate. Hepatocellular carcinoma and intrahepatic cholangiocarcinoma (ICC) are the two main types of primary liver cancer (PLC), each with its own set of complexities. Secondary or metastatic liver cancer is more common than PLC.

pmc-11643170.title: Effect of Enterococcus hirae GS22 Fermentation-Assisted Extraction on the Physicochemical and Bioactivities of Sea Cucumber Intestinal Polysaccharides
pmc-11643170.creator: Xiqian Tan, Xiaoqing Wang, Fangchao Cui, Ali Zeshan, Dangfeng Wang, Xuepeng Li, Jianrong Li, George O’Doherty
pmc-11643170.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2024). The sea cucumber intestine (SI), a secondary product from sea cucumber processing, contains polysaccharides as one of its active ingredients, and fermentation is an effective method for extracting bioactive substances from food by-products. In this study, to explore the effect of Enterococcus hirae GS22 fermentation on the extraction of SI polysaccharides, the polysaccharides were extracted through the SI with and without Enterococcus hirae GS22 fermentation, and the obtained polysaccharides were designated as SC-PF and SC-P.

pmc-12654528.title: Improvement of Cancer Care—Analysis of ESGO Quality Indicators for the Surgical Treatment of Endometrial Cancer in Slovenian and Croatian Gynaecologic Oncology Departments
pmc-12654528.creator: Maja Pakiž, Marko Klarić, Andraž Dovnik, Gabrijela Sopta Primorac, Jure Knez, Đuro Despot, Leyla Al Mahdawi, Marina Pranjic, Aleks Brumec, Tadej Turković, Andrej Cokan, Paolo Zola, Carlo Ronsini
pmc-12654528.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2025). Background and Objectives: This study aims to analyze ESGO quality indicators for the surgical treatment of endometrial cancer patients at two gynecologic oncology departments in Slovenia and Croatia, providing insights for improving cancer care. Materials and Methods: We conducted a retrospective analysis of clinical data to evaluate ESGO quality indicators for surgical treatment of endometrial cancer patients from 2020 to 2022. ESGO quality indicators were calculated, and the results were discussed to formulate suggestions for enhancing cancer care.

pmc-12875765.title: Physicochemical, functional, and evolutionary characteristics of protein loop regions in human and Escherichia coli proteomes
pmc-12875765.creator: Lin Zhang, Hafumi Nishi
pmc-12875765.description: Protein loops play crucial roles in the formation of binding and enzyme active sites. However, general structural and biological characteristics of these loops remain unclear. In this study, we investigated loops from structural and evolutionary perspectives using the entire protein data bank (PDB), Homo sapiens, and Escherichia coli proteins. We found that loop sequences tended to be unique among species.

pmc-13380130.title: Hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis‐like syndrome after CD19‐directed CAR T‐cells for B‐cell lymphoma and B‐cell acute lymphoblastic leukemia: A LYSA, SFCE, and GRAALL study from the DESCAR‐T registry
pmc-13380130.creator: Nicolas Gower, Roch Houot, Cécile Pizot, André Baruchel, Marie‐Emilie Dourthe, David Beauvais, Thomas Gastinne, Gabriel Brisou, Rémy Dulery, Stéphanie Guidez, Jean‐Jacques Tudesq, Adrien Chauchet, Laura Herbreteau, Arnaud Campidelli, Jacques‐Olivier Bay, Pierre Sesques, Edmond Chiche, François‐Xavie
pmc-13380130.description: While cytokine release syndrome (CRS) and immune effector cell–associated neurotoxicity syndrome (ICANS) are well‐recognized toxicities of CAR T‐cell therapy, immune effector cell‐associated hemophagocytic lymphohistiocytosis‐like syndrome (IEC‐HS) remains poorly characterized. We aimed to describe the incidence, clinical features, management, and outcomes of IEC‐HS using real‐world data from the DESCAR‐T registry (NCT04328298).
